name: Dragonborn
text:
**Creature Type:** Humanoid

**Size:** Medium (about 5–7 feet tall)

**Speed:** 30 feet

As a Dragonborn, you have these special traits.

***Draconic Ancestry.*** Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance.

**Draconic Ancestors**

| Dragon | Damage Type | Dragon | Damage Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Black | Acid | Gold | Fire |
| Blue | Lightning | Green | Poison |
| Brass | Fire | Red | Fire |
| Bronze | Lightning | Silver | Cold |
| Copper | Acid | White | Cold |

***Breath Weapon.*** When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

***Damage Resistance.*** You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

***Darkvision.*** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

***Draconic Flight.*** When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

text:
**Creature Type:** Humanoid

**Size:** Medium (about 5–6 feet tall)

**Speed:** 30 feet

As an Elf, you have these special traits.

***Darkvision.*** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

***Elven Lineage.*** You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

**Elven Lineages**

| Lineage | Level 1 | Level 3 | Level 5 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Wood Elf | Your Speed increases to 35 feet. You also know the Druidcraft cantrip. | Longstrider | Pass without Trace |

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

***Fey Ancestry.*** You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

***Keen Senses.*** You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

***Trance.*** You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

name: Gnome
text:
**Creature Type:** Humanoid

**Size:** Small (about 3–4 feet tall)

**Speed:** 30 feet

As a Gnome, you have these special traits.

***Darkvision.*** You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

***Gnomish Cunning.*** You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

***Gnomish Lineage.*** You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage):

**Forest Gnome.** You know the _Minor Illusion_ cantrip. You also always have the _Speak with Animals_ spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

**Rock Gnome.** You know the _Mending_ and _Prestidigitation_ cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting _Prestidigitation_ to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. When you create the device, you determine its function by choosing one effect from _Prestidigitation_; the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch. If the chosen effect has options within it, you choose one of those options for the device when you create it. For example, if you choose the spell’s ignite-extinguish effect, you determine whether the device ignites or extinguishes fire; the device doesn’t do both. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.

name: Goliath
text:
**Creature Type:** Humanoid

**Size:** Medium (about 7–8 feet tall)

**Speed:** 35 feet

As a Goliath, you have these special traits.

***Giant Ancestry.*** You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest:

**Cloud’s Jaunt (Cloud Giant).** As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

**Fire’s Burn (Fire Giant).** When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

**Frost’s Chill (Frost Giant).** When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

**Hill’s Tumble (Hill Giant).** When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.

**Stone’s Endurance (Stone Giant).** When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

**Storm’s Thunder (Storm Giant).** When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

***Large Form.*** Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you’re in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

***Powerful Build.*** You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

summary: Living constructs of wood and metal built for the Last War, who feel pain and emotion.

name: Boggart

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.summary: When your attack or spell damages a creature larger than you, add PB to the damage. At most once per turn; PB uses per Long Rest.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.summary: Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

summary: Squat, beast-featured goblinoids of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor who love brewing potions (Humanoids that also count as goblinoids): darkvision, fey-tough minds, extra damage against bigger foes and a slippery escape.

name: Faerie

traits.name: Fairy Magic
traits.summary: Know Druidcraft; Faerie Fire at level 3 and Enlarge/Reduce at level 5, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the species.

traits.name: Flight
traits.summary: Fly Speed equal to your Speed, unusable in Medium or Heavy armor.

options.name: Lorwyn
options.summary: No further trait.

options.name: Shadowmoor
options.summary: Darkvision out to 120 ft.

summary: Flower-born insectile fey of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor with wings, antennae and a taste for pranks: they fly and cast nature magic that grows with level.

name: Flamekin
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen with the species

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.summary: Resistance to Fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.summary: Know Produce Flame; Burning Hands at level 3 and Flame Blade (no material component) at level 5, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the species.

summary: People of living fire and stone who chase self-discovery along the Path of Flame: darkvision, fire resistance and fire spells that grow with level.

name: Lorwyn Changeling
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

traits.name: Shape Self
traits.summary: Action: take a two-legged Humanoid shape (which can wear Humanoid clothes and armor of your size) or a four-legged Beast shape.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Delightful Imitator
traits.summary: Proficiency in Deception or Performance.

traits.name: Unpredictable Movement
traits.summary: On rolling Initiative without Disadvantage, move up to half your Speed at once.

summary: Blue-green, yellow-eyed fey shapeshifters whose crude copies of beasts and people fool no one but charm many: two body shapes, keen darkvision and a quick start in a fight.

name: Rimekin
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

traits.name: Cold Fire Magic
traits.summary: Know Ray of Frost; Ice Knife at level 3 and Flame Blade at level 5, always prepared and each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). This Flame Blade deals Cold instead of Fire. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the species.

traits.name: Cold Resistance
traits.summary: Resistance to Cold damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

summary: Flamekin turned cold by choosing logic over impulse, their flames now icy blue: cold resistance, darkvision and frost spells that grow with level.

name: Dhampir
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climb Speed equal to your Speed; from level 3 you also scale walls and ceilings with your hands free.

traits.name: Trace of Undeath
traits.summary: Resistance to Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Vampiric Bite
traits.summary: An Unarmed Strike can be a bite for 1d4 + CON Piercing. PB times per Long Rest, a bite that damages a creature other than a Construct or Undead also empowers you in one of two ways.

options.name: Drain
options.summary: Heal HP equal to the bite’s Piercing damage.

options.name: Strengthen
options.summary: Add the bite’s Piercing damage as a bonus to your next ability check or attack roll within 1 minute.

summary: A living person touched by vampirism: quick, climbs walls, shrugs off necrotic harm and feeds with a draining bite.

name: Hexblood
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Eerie Token
traits.summary: Bonus Action: make a token from a lock of hair, nail or similar; it lasts until your next Long Rest and you can make one per Long Rest. Within 10 miles of it you can message its holder or see and hear through it.

options.name: Distant Message
options.summary: Magic action: send a telepathic message of up to 25 words to whoever holds or carries the token, within 10 miles.

options.name: Remote Viewing
options.summary: Magic action within 10 miles: see and hear from the token’s location for 1 minute (ends if Incapacitated or at will); the token then crumbles.

traits.name: Hex Magic
traits.summary: Disguise Self and Hex always prepared; cast each free once per Long Rest, or with your slots. INT, WIS or CHA is the casting ability (pick when you choose the species).

summary: A Fey person remade by a hag’s bargain or other witchery, able to spy through a cursed token and work hexes.

name: Lupin
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Feral Pounce
traits.summary: Unarmed Strikes deal Slashing. Once per turn, an Unarmed Strike hit during your Attack action can both deal damage and Shove.

traits.name: Howl
traits.summary: Bonus Action: chosen creatures within 15 ft make a WIS save (DC 8 + CON + PB) or have Disadvantage on attacks and saves until your next turn starts. PB uses per Long Rest.

traits.name: Werewolf Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in Perception, Stealth or Survival.

summary: A wolfish humanoid left half-changed by a werewolf’s curse, with keen senses, raking claws and a dreadful howl.

name: Reborn
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

traits.name: Escaped Death
traits.summary: Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

traits.name: Everlasting
traits.summary: No Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation; you don’t sleep and can’t be magically slept. A Long Rest takes you 4 hours of motionless, conscious inactivity.

traits.name: Knowledge from a Past Life
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill. PB times per Long Rest, after failing an ability check, add 1d6 to the d20 and maybe succeed.

traits.name: Strange Endurance
traits.summary: Resistance to Cold, Necrotic or Poison (your choice).

summary: Someone who died yet lives on, by curse, magic or stitched science, carrying memories of a former life.

name: Dracthyr

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Gliding Wings
traits.summary: In natural form and not Incapacitated: a fall counts up to 100 ft less for damage, and you drift 2 ft sideways per 1 ft you drop.

traits.name: Natural Weaponry
traits.summary: In natural form, Bonus Action: an Unarmed Strike with wings or tail to Shove a creature.

traits.name: Visage
traits.summary: Magic action: switch between your natural form and a humanoid visage whose look you set when you pick the species; clothing, gear and statistics don't change.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.summary: From level 5, Bonus Action: gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest.

summary: Dragon soldiers made from the essence of all five dragonflights: they glide, strike with wings and tail, wear a humanoid visage, and from level 5 take short flights.

name: Draenei

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Eredar Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Draenei, Krokul, Lightforged or Man'ari: a resistance and a cantrip at level 1, then a spell at levels 3 and 5, always prepared and each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the lineage.

traits.name: Heroic Presence
traits.summary: Casting a spell from your Eredar Lineage gives you Heroic Inspiration if you lack it. Once per Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Draenei
options.summary: Necrotic Resistance and Spare the Dying; Healing Word at 3, Prayer of Healing at 5.

options.name: Krokul
options.summary: Poison Resistance and Poison Spray; Ray of Sickness at 3, Hold Person at 5.

options.name: Lightforged
options.summary: Radiant Resistance and Sacred Flame; Guiding Bolt at 3, Aid at 5.

options.name: Man'ari
options.summary: Fire Resistance and Fire Bolt; Hellish Rebuke at 3, Darkness at 5.

summary: Exiled eredar shaped by the naaru, fel or the Legion: darkvision, a lineage of resistance and spells, and Heroic Inspiration when they cast those spells.

name: Dwarf (Warcraft)

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.summary: Poison Resistance, and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.summary: +1 HP maximum, and +1 more each level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.summary: Bonus Action: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes while on or touching stone (natural or worked). PB times per Long Rest.

summary: Hardy descendants of the stone earthen: long darkvision, poison resistance, extra HP every level and a stone-borne tremorsense.

name: Earthen

traits.name: Azerite Surge
traits.summary: Replace one attack of your Attack action with a 15-ft Cone: chosen creatures heal 1d10, the rest make a DEX save (DC 8 + PB + CON) for 1d10 Radiant, half on success. Both grow to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11 and 4d10 at 17; PB times per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Earthen Resilience
traits.summary: Poison Resistance, and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

traits.name: Ingest Minerals
traits.summary: Malnutrition never gives you Exhaustion.

traits.name: Quiet Contemplation
traits.summary: Hit Point Dice spent at the end of a Short Rest each heal 1 extra HP.

summary: Titan-made folk of living, Azerite-veined stone who resist poison, need no food, and trade an attack for a cone that heals friends and burns foes.

name: Elf (Warcraft)

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Blood Elf, High Elf, Night Elf, Nightborne or Void Elf: its level 1 benefit, then a spell at levels 3 and 5, always prepared and each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the lineage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.summary: Proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.summary: No sleep needed and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of conscious meditation.

options.name: Blood Elf
options.summary: Prestidigitation, which you can swap for another Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest; Detect Magic at 3, Arcane Vigor at 5.

options.name: High Elf
options.summary: Prestidigitation, which you can swap for another Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest; Detect Magic at 3, Misty Step at 5.

options.name: Night Elf
options.summary: Stealth proficiency, and Hide as a Bonus Action in Dim Light or Darkness; Longstrider at 3, Pass without Trace at 5.

options.name: Nightborne
options.summary: Darkvision grows to 120 ft, and Arcane Pulse; Faerie Fire at 3, Darkness at 5.

options.name: Void Elf
options.summary: Darkvision grows to 120 ft, and Mind Sliver; Entropic Embrace at 3, Misty Step at 5.

summary: Azeroth's elves (night elves, nightborne, high, blood and void elves): darkvision, fey-touched minds, trance, and a lineage of innate spells.

name: Forsaken
sizeText: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Deathly Endurance
traits.summary: Necrotic Resistance.

traits.name: Everlasting
traits.summary: No Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation; no sleep needed and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of motionless, conscious rest.

traits.name: Touch of the Grave
traits.summary: When you deal damage to a creature, add PB d4s of Necrotic damage and regain HP equal to that extra damage. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Will of the Forsaken
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened.

summary: Undead freed from the Lich King's will: necrotic resistance, no need for breath, food or sleep, and a once-a-day life-draining strike.

name: Gnome (Warcraft)

traits.name: Gnome or Mechagnome
traits.summary: Choose gnome (Humanoid: Darkvision, Gnomish Cunning, Gnomish Lineage) or mechagnome (Construct: Built for Success, Emergency Fail-Safe, Mechanical Nature, Sentry's Rest, Specialized Design); your pick's traits are listed with it.

options.name: Gnome
options.summary: Humanoid. Darkvision 60 ft, Advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves, and the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips; a 10-minute Prestidigitation casting builds a Tiny clockwork gadget (AC 5, 1 HP).

options.name: Darkvision
options.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

options.name: Gnomish Cunning
options.summary: Advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves.

options.name: Gnomish Lineage
options.summary: Know Mending and Prestidigitation. Spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to build a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP) that repeats one chosen effect of the spell whenever someone touches it as a Bonus Action; up to three at once, each falling apart after 8 hours or when you take it apart (Utilize action).

options.name: Mechagnome
options.summary: Construct, Small (about 4 ft). Add 1d4 to D20 Tests, heal with a Reaction when Bloodied, resist poison, rest 6 hours without sleep, and two tool proficiencies.

options.name: Built for Success
options.summary: Add 1d4 to a D20 Test, even after rolling but before the result. PB times per Long Rest.

options.name: Emergency Fail-Safe
options.summary: Reaction on becoming Bloodied: spend and roll one Hit Point Die, healing the roll + CON (minimum 1). Once per Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Mechanical Nature
options.summary: Poison Resistance; Advantage on saves to avoid or end Paralyzed or Poisoned; no Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation.

options.name: Sentry's Rest
options.summary: No sleep needed; a Long Rest takes 6 hours of motionless, conscious rest.

options.name: Specialized Design
options.summary: Proficiency with two tools of your choice.

summary: Tinkering gnomes of Gnomeregan, or mechagnomes who rebuilt themselves as living machines: pick one at creation.

name: Goblin

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.summary: When your attack or spell damages a creature larger than you, add damage equal to PB of the same type. PB times per Long Rest, at most once per turn.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.summary: Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

summary: Kezan's quick-witted cartel folk: they shrug off charms, slip away as a Bonus Action and hit bigger foes harder.

name: Haranir

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Gift of the World Trees
traits.summary: Proficiency in Nature and Survival.

traits.name: Haranir Magic
traits.summary: Know Druidcraft and Thorn Whip; Entangle at level 3 and Spike Growth at 5, always prepared and each castable once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Cast with INT, WIS or CHA, picked with the species.

summary: Secretive druidic folk of Harandar, the realm under the World Trees' roots: long darkvision, nature lore, and thorny innate magic.

name: Human (Warcraft)
sizeText: Medium or Small (chosen with the species), as the Player's Handbook human

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.summary: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.summary: An Origin feat of your choice; Dalaran humans often take Magic Initiate (Wizard).

summary: Azeroth's humans, from Stormwind to Kul Tiras and the Arathi Empire, use the Player's Handbook human traits; their homelands add Origin feats such as Arathi Heritage, Child of the Sea and Will to Survive.

name: Orc (Warcraft)

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.summary: Bonus Action: Dash and gain Temporary HP equal to PB. PB times per Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 120 ft.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.summary: Dropped to 0 HP but not killed outright: go to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

summary: Draenor-born orcs of the Horde: long darkvision, bursts of speed that toughen them, and refusing to fall.

name: Pandaren

traits.name: Bouncy
traits.summary: Resistance to Bludgeoning damage from falling.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Inner Peace
traits.summary: Hit Point Dice spent after a Short Rest each heal 1 extra HP.

traits.name: Quaking Palm
traits.summary: Once you land a melee hit on a creature during your turn, moving doesn't provoke that creature's Opportunity Attacks until the turn ends.

summary: Easygoing bear-folk of Pandaria and the Wandering Isle: they bounce off falls, recover well on rests and slip past foes they strike.

name: Tauren

traits.name: Horns
traits.summary: An Unarmed Strike that deals damage can deal 1d6 + STR Piercing instead of its normal damage.

traits.name: Goring Rush
traits.summary: Right after you Dash and move 20+ ft on your turn, Bonus Action: one Unarmed Strike.

traits.name: Hammering Horns
traits.summary: Right after a melee hit during your Attack action, Bonus Action: Shove that target (within 5 ft) with an Unarmed Strike, pushing it up to 10 ft.

traits.name: Tauren Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Mulgore, Highmountain or Taunka. Its save DCs are 8 + PB + STR, CON or WIS (picked with the lineage).

options.name: Mulgore Tauren
options.summary: War stomp: swap one attack of your Attack action for a stomp; chosen creatures in a 5-ft Emanation make a CON save or are Stunned until your turn ends. Not while Prone, flying, climbing or swimming.

options.name: Highmountain Tauren
options.summary: Action: move up to your Speed through creatures' spaces without provoking Opportunity Attacks; each Medium or smaller creature you enter makes a STR save or takes PB + STR damage and falls Prone (once per turn each).

options.name: Taunka
options.summary: +1 AC and Cold Resistance from a shaggy hide.

summary: Towering bovine folk of Mulgore, Highmountain and Northrend who gore and shove with their horns and carry a lineage gift.

name: Troll

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.summary: Advantage on attack rolls while Bloodied.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Troll Healing
traits.summary: Hit Point Dice spent after a Short Rest heal their maximum roll plus your CON modifier instead of being rolled.

traits.name: Troll Lineage
traits.summary: Pick Amani, Darkspear or Zandalari troll.

options.name: Amani Troll
options.summary: Spending Heroic Inspiration restores 1 spent Hit Point Die.

options.name: Darkspear Troll
options.summary: When you Dash, Difficult Terrain of ice, rubble, snow or undergrowth costs no extra movement until your turn ends.

options.name: Zandalari Troll
options.summary: A natural 1 on a D20 Test gives you Heroic Inspiration at the end of that turn.

summary: Ancient loa-worshipping folk of Azeroth's jungles, forests and ice: they fight harder when hurt, heal fast on rests and carry a tribal lineage.

name: Vulpera

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.summary: Fire Resistance.

traits.name: Nose for Trouble
traits.summary: The first damage you take after rolling Initiative drops by your level (minimum 0).

traits.name: Vulpera Nimbleness
traits.summary: Pass through (but not stop in) the space of a creature a size larger than you.

summary: Small fox-folk desert caravaners: fire resistant, hard to pin down, and quick to brace for the first blow of a fight.

name: Worgen

traits.name: Darkflight
traits.summary: Bonus Action: take a bestial form for 1 minute (revert as a Bonus Action) and gain Temporary HP equal to 2 × PB. PB times per Long Rest.

options.name: Increased Speed
options.summary: +10 ft Speed.

options.name: Reactive Movement
options.summary: Reaction when a creature finishes its turn within 5 ft of you: move up to 10 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

options.name: Necrotic Resistance
options.summary: Necrotic Resistance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Instinctual Shift
traits.summary: On rolling Initiative with a Darkflight use left, shift into bestial form at once (no action).

summary: Gilneans carrying the wolf curse, now under control: they shift into a bestial form that is faster, tougher and harder to pin down.

name: Bariaur

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Ram
traits.summary: Once per turn, an Unarmed Strike hit during the Attack action after moving 10+ ft straight at the target can both deal damage and Shove.

traits.name: Stable Stance
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid Prone.

traits.name: Wanderer’s Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in Animal Handling, Arcana, Nature or Survival.

summary: Celestials of Ysgard, humanoid above the waist and sheep below, who love wandering, treasure, revelry and battles against evil: fast, sure-footed and able to ram foes.

name: Duskling

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Enhanced Jump
traits.summary: Running High Jumps go 2 ft higher and running Long Jumps 10 ft farther.

traits.name: Inner Magic
traits.summary: After each Long Rest pick one benefit, kept until you change it. Bonus Action: switch to another, PB times per Long Rest.

options.name: Ardor
options.summary: Advantage on CHA checks and on saves to avoid or end Frightened.

options.name: Mobility
options.summary: +10 ft Speed; climbing and swimming cost no extra movement.

options.name: Vigor
options.summary: Temporary HP equal to PB, and Advantage on STR (Athletics) and DEX (Acrobatics) checks.

summary: Fey who left the Feywild for forests across the planes, often in herding communities that roam with their flocks: they leap far and channel inner magic into a chosen boost.
